name: Seitenkan ~Ore no Naka de Ikeba Ii Daro!?~
original_name: 性転換～オレの膣内でいけばいいだろ!？～
source:
Akira lived from day to day without any change. Every day he protected his little sister from their alcoholic father. School was a drag. It was a boys-only prep school.  "I hate this life!" he thought. One traffic accident later, and he awoke as a female. (!?) 

There was no way "she" could protect her sister like this... unless she played to her old man's perverted nature. "Well hello cutie, you want to take her place?" Akira's father offered predictably. To spare her cute imouto, Akira spread her new feminine legs. In spirit still a boy... and with his own father... it was like a nightmare. But physically, another feeling took over... 

Teacher and student, father and son/daugther sexual experiences. Akira lives day to day with huge change. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE105818.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
明每天都过着没有任何改变的生活。他每天都保护他的妹妹免受酗酒父亲的伤害。学校是一个拖累。那是一所男子预科学校。“我讨厌这样的生活！”他想。一场车祸后，他醒来时变成了女性。（！？） 

“她”不可能就这样保护自己的妹妹……除非她发挥了她老爷子的变态本性。“你好，小可爱，你想代替她吗？”阿基拉的父亲如预料地提出了这个建议。为了不伤害可爱的妹妹，阿基拉张开了她新的女性化双腿。精神上仍然是个男孩……而且和他自己的父亲在一起……这就像一场噩梦。但在身体上，另一种感觉占据了…… 

老师和学生、父亲和儿子/女儿的性经历。阿基拉的日常生活发生了巨大的变化。
